topic: 专项练习 - 情态动词的理解与运用 (Modal Verbs: Ability, Permission, Obligation & Advice)

questions.question: Excuse me, Mr. Harrison. ______ I borrow the science magazine on your desk?
questions.explanation: 向老师等长辈或在正式场合请求许可时，常用 'May I...?'，意为“我可以……吗？”，语气最为礼貌客气。

questions.question: Leo was sick last week, so he ______ attend the inter-school chess tournament.
questions.explanation: 句子叙述的是上周（last week）过去的事情，表示过去没有能力做某事，应用 could 的否定式 couldn't。

questions.question: Look at the red sign! It says people ______ feed the animals in the petting zoo.
questions.explanation: mustn't 表示强烈的“禁止、千万不可”，常用于警示标志和规则约束。

questions.question: Tomorrow is a public holiday, which means we ______ wake up early.
questions.explanation: 明天是法定假期，说明“没有必要”早起。don't have to 表示“没有必要、不必”，符合语境。

questions.question: You ______ finish your paragraph before lunchtime, or you won't have time for dessert.
questions.explanation: should 表示“应该”，常用于提出建议或合理要求。

questions.question: Mia ______ speak three languages fluently: English, Mandarin, and French.
questions.explanation: can 用来表示先天的能力或后天习得的技能（如语言能力）。

questions.question: Take an umbrella with you. The weather forecast says it ______ rain later this afternoon.
questions.explanation: might 表示对未来情况把握不大、不确定的推测，意为“可能、也许”。

questions.question: All passengers ______ fasten their seatbelts during takeoff and landing.
questions.explanation: must 表示客观规定、安全法则或强制性义务，意为“必须”。

questions.question: You ______ play video games until all your chores are finished. That's Mum's rule.
questions.explanation: can't 在日常生活中常用于表达“不被允许做某事”，符合家庭规则的表达。

questions.question: ______ you please pass me the glue stick, Ethan?
questions.explanation: Could you please...? 是标准的礼貌请求句型，比 Can you please...? 更加温和客气。

questions.question: The library has already bought plenty of copies, so the students ______ purchase the novel themselves.
questions.explanation: 图书馆已有足够藏书，因此学生“不需要/不必”自己买。needn't 表示“不必”。

questions.question: When Grandpa was twenty, he ______ run ten kilometres without stopping.
questions.explanation: 根据时间状语 When Grandpa was twenty 可知是过去的事实，用 could 表示过去具备的能力。

questions.question: Students ______ shout in the corridors; it disturbs other classes.
questions.explanation: 走廊内禁止大声喧哗，mustn't 用于校规等严厉的禁止行为。

questions.question: We have plenty of time before the museum tour starts, so we ______ hurry.
questions.explanation: 时间很充裕，因此“不需要赶时间”。don't need to do sth. 表示“不需要做某事”。

questions.question: You ______ rub your eyes with dirty hands because it can cause an infection.
questions.explanation: 此处为健康建议，shouldn't 表示“不应该”，劝阻对方不要这样做。

questions.question: Where is Oliver? — He ______ be in the computer lab, but I am not entirely certain.
questions.explanation: 后半句提到 'I am not entirely certain'（我不是完全确定），表示可能性较低的推测，应用 might。

questions.question: ______ we go to the botanical garden this Saturday, Mum?
questions.explanation: Shall we...? 常用于第一人称（I/we）提出建议或征求对方意见，意为“我们……好吗？”

questions.question: In the UK, cyclists ______ wear helmets and obey traffic signals for their own safety.
questions.explanation: ought to 后面接动词原形，表示“应当、应该”，侧重道义或安全守则上的责任。

questions.question: Look at Sarah's wet shoes. It ______ be raining outside.
questions.explanation: 看到 Sarah 湿透的鞋子做出有把握的肯定推测，must be 表示“一定、肯定”。

questions.question: You ______ touch the oven tray! It has just come out of the oven and is scorching hot.
questions.explanation: 盘子滚烫，有严重危险，mustn't 表示“绝对不能/千万不可触碰”。

questions.question: — Need I hand in the science report today? — No, you ______.
questions.explanation: 以情态动词 Need 开头的一般疑问句，否定回答通常用 'No, you needn't.' 或 'No, you don't have to.'。

questions.question: When Emily was five years old, she ______ read simple chapter books by herself.
questions.explanation: 叙述五岁时的过去能力，用 was able to，B 和 C 为现在时，D 项意思不符。

questions.question: That boy running across the field ______ be Arthur because Arthur is at the dentist right now.
questions.explanation: can't be 用于表示有把握的否定推测，意为“不可能”。因为 Arthur 正在牙医诊所，所以操场上的男孩“绝不可能是”他。

questions.question: You ______ bring your own tennis racket; the school club provides all the equipment.
questions.explanation: 学校提供所有器材，因此“没有必要”自己带。don't have to 意为“不必”。

questions.question: Children ______ spend too much time staring at screens without taking breaks.
questions.explanation: 提出合理健康的生活忠告时，用 shouldn't 表达“不应当”。

questions.question: ______ I carry those heavy art supplies to the studio for you, Mrs. Davis?
questions.explanation: Shall I...? 常用于主动为他人提供帮助，意为“需要我替您……吗？”

questions.question: My father ______ work late tonight because the project deadline is tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: 主语为第三人称单数 My father，且受到工作截止期限的客观制约，用 has to 表示“不得不、必须”。

questions.question: If you don't feel well during P.E. class, you ______ tell the teacher immediately.
questions.explanation: 身体不适时“应当”立即告知老师。ought to do sth. 表明理应采取的做法。

questions.question: — May I leave the classroom now? — Yes, you ______.
questions.explanation: 对 'May I...?' 请求许可的肯定回答，通常可以用 'Yes, you may.' 或 'Yes, you can.'，此处选项中 can 最为地道贴切。

questions.question: We ______ waste clean water because fresh water is a limited and precious resource.
questions.explanation: 淡水宝贵，我们“绝不能”浪费水资源。mustn't 表示坚决的禁止和道德原则。
